title: Kansas City wages compared with Omaha
summary: Jones thought Kansas City musicians earned fortunes but Andy Kirk's men made $17.50 and Moten's $16.50, less than his Omaha job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So these guys were down in Kansas City and you thought they were making a lot of bread?

I knew they were making money. It didn't dawn on me till later on, after I left and went into Kansas City in '33 and went back and went back again - I thought these people were making fabulous money. Andy Kirk's band was making $17.50 a week. I just come off a job at $22.50.
Twenty-two dollars and fifty cents, that is.
And I only worked 4 hours a night with tips. And Bennie Moten's band was playing more and they made $16.50.
